title: Merge intervals
statementMd:
Merge all overlapping (or touching) intervals `[start, end]`; return the merged list sorted by start.

**Example:** `merge_intervals([[1, 3], [2, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]])` returns `[[1, 6], [8, 10], [15, 18]]`.
hints: Sort by start, extend the last interval when overlapping.
